original.statement: Istio 1.24.0 adds a retry policy for inbound requests that automatically resets requests the service has not seen/processed; setting ENABLE_INBOUND_RETRY_POLICY to false reverts it.

decision.reason: [ev-e09c6cbd06dc] says 1.24.0 "Added" an inbound retry policy, on by default, which "can be reverted by setting \"ENABLE_INBOUND_RETRY_POLICY\" to false". The subject spelling matches the evidence exactly. The variable is the toggle for the newly added feature, so "added" is a fair reading. Because the evidence doesn't say outright that the variable is new, confidence is low.
